doc: Both slots present (databricks.fbl#configuration; FBL 0.10, section 5.2; spec 066, edge case 16): the own slot is read, schema gold, and target is removed at the next write of the schema. Its body is written here.

steps.doc: Setting the schema replaces schema's value and removes target in the same edit.

expectFiles.../pipelines.yml:
resources:
  pipelines:
    legacy:
      name: Legacy target
      catalog: main
      target: silver
    both:
      name: Both written
      schema: platinum

steps.doc: Undo puts gold and target back.

expectFiles.../pipelines.yml:
resources:
  pipelines:
    legacy:
      name: Legacy target
      catalog: main
      target: silver
    both:
      name: Both written
      schema: gold
      target: silver
